task_description: The agents must collaboratively develop a feature for a software project. This involves writing the initial code according to provided requirements, conducting code reviews, testing the software, and handling code integration. The agents need to ensure that the final software is bug-free and fully integrated.
expected_outcome: The software feature is developed, reviewed, tested, and integrated without any bugs or issues.

agents.description: Responsible for writing the initial code based on the requirements provided.
Examines the code written by the developer to identify any issues or improvements.
Runs tests on the code to ensure it meets the requirements and is bug-free.
Integrates the reviewed and tested code into the main codebase, handling any merge conflicts.
